# Restart card

Copy this somewhere you'll see it when you come back. Only fill in what's actually confirmed. Leave a line blank rather than guess.

```text
Task:
Done:
Resume at:
Next action:
Blocker:
```

Example:

```text
Task: Expenses claim
Done: entered the Bristol train
Resume at: expenses portal, claim 2, "fare amount" field
Next action: type £42.10 from the receipt photo
Blocker: none
```

When you return, paste the card and say "where was I?".
